the evolution of HR has been a long journey and it has evolved from Personnel Management (PM) to HRM to e HRM.
the HRM practices have changed over the period of times, and now it is in the form of E-HRM.
e HRM has a significant positive impact on organizational effectiveness.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evolution of HR practices and the impact of ICT on HRM.
the role of ICT in HRM.
the evolution of human resource management (HRM) over time.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the evolution of HR from the 20th century to the 21st century has been remarkable.
the HRM has a very important role to play in the organizational effectiveness and sustainability in the 21st century.
the evolution of HR from the past till date has been a long journey and it has undergone several changes and modifications in the past and the future will be more dynamic in terms of its evolution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HRM has evolved over time from the traditional HRM to the modern HRM and then towards e HRM.
the role of HRM is evolving with the changing time.
HRM has evolved from the traditional role to a strategic partner of the organization and has become an important function in the organization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the evolution of HR is not just an evolutionary process but a revolutionary process.
the evolution of HR has been driven by two major forces, namely the changing business environment and technology.
the evolution of the human resource management (HRM) function is a process of change, not a destination.
